mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate rises by more than 0.25% over the next month, the S&P 500 forward 20-day return is expected to be negative due to higher real borrowing costs compressing equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > (prev value + 0.25%) in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the identified FEDFUNDS rise, or the effect is explained by other variables.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in PAYEMS (labor market activity) of at least 2% over the next month is associated with a positive S&P 500 forward return of 20 days, reflecting optimism about employment strength.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > (prev value * 1.02) in the following month
failure_condition: No significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS meets the threshold, or the effect is reversed in weak labor markets.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in GDPC1 (goods demand) of at least 10% over the prior quarter is a leading indicator of stronger economic momentum, predicting a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > (prev value * 1.10) over the prior quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during such a GDPC1 surge, or the effect is absent in deflationary regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of over 5% signals supply-side weakness, which is expected to produce a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < (prev value * 0.95) in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the INDPRO decline, or the effect is absent in non-crisis periods.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls below 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to deliver a positive 20-day forward return as lower labor market friction supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day return (p > 0.05) during the three-month UNRATE decline, or the effect is not robust across multiple cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both HOUST (housing starts) and PAYEMS (labor) by at least 5% over the next month suggests dual momentum, predicting a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > (prev value * 1.05) AND PAYEMS > (prev value * 1.05) in the following month
failure_condition: No significant positive return (p > 0.05) when both proxies meet the threshold, or the interaction is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation index) below 2%, the S&P 500 60-day forward return is expected to be positive as lower inflation reduces discounting of future cash flows.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the CPIAUCSL decline, or the effect is absent outside disinflationary phases.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) falls by more than 8% in the next month, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is predicted to be negative due to weak consumer demand signals.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < (prev value * 0.92) in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the RSAFS drop, or the effect is not observed in non-recessionary settings.
